summary.root_cause: The 8 key @-prefixed benchmark analysis scripts and 2 phase8 scripts all pass raw checkpoint (log-space) scales directly to fully_fused_projection() or rasterization(). This causes the CUDA kernel's 'quat_scale_to_covar_preci' to construct covariances from log values (~ -6.36) instead of activated values (~0.0017), inflating all covariances by ~10 million times. Every Gaussian covers the entire image. Additionally, fast_gauss_renderer.py does not apply torch.exp() in its prepare_scene/render path, inconsistent with all other renderer adapters.
summary.fix_pattern: All scripts in the invalidated list need 'torch.exp()' applied to checkpoint scales before passing to fully_fused_projection() or rasterization(). The pattern from @root_cause_corrected.py is the reference fix.
